title: Tokenizers
motto: Your LLM does not read English. It reads integers. The tokenizer decides whether those integers carry meaning or waste it.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Your LLM does not read English. It reads integers. The tokenizer decides whether those integers carry meaning or waste it.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Your LLM does not read English. It does not read any language. It reads numbers.

The gap between "Hello, world!" and [15496, 11, 995, 0] is the tokenizer. Every word, every space, every punctuation mark must be converted into an integer before a model can process it. This conversion is not neutral. It bakes assumptions into the model that cannot be undone later.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: BPE/WordPiece split text into subword IDs for the model.

steps.title: Implement tok
steps.body: Implement the function in the workspace. Use hints if stuck — first-try passes earn bonus XP.

code.starter:
def char_to_ids(text,vocab):
    return [vocab.index(c) for c in text if c in vocab]
